title: core.payment.refunded v1
description: Published when CORE returns money that had already been captured. A refund is not a void and not an un-capture: it posts a balanced reversal into the ledger, the authorization keeps its captured status, and the hold is NOT restored — the funds simply become spendable again. A subscriber that treats this as a cancellation of the original capture will double count.

amount_minor.description: The amount returned by THIS refund.

refunded_minor.description: Total refunded against the authorization, including this refund.

captured_minor.description: Total captured, which is the ceiling on refunds and is never reduced by one.
